title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 59 (Application of payment where debt to be discharged is indicated)

content.overview: Section 59 provides that where a debtor, owing several distinct debts to one person, makes a payment to him, either with express intimation, or under circumstances implying, that the payment is to be applied to the discharge of some particular debt, the payment, if accepted, must be applied accordingly.
content.glance: Debtor indicates (expressly or by implication) which debt a payment discharges → payment if accepted must be so applied.
content.study: Where a debtor owes several distinct debts and makes a payment with express intimation or under circumstances implying application to a particular debt, the payment, if accepted, must be applied to that debt. Current-law framing: identify multiple debts; test express or implied intimation of application; apply the payment to the indicated debt if accepted.

sections.heading: Indicated debt
sections.body: Payment with express intimation or under circumstances implying application to a particular debt must, if accepted, be applied accordingly.

provisions.title: Application of payment where debt to be discharged is indicated

examples.title: Express appropriation
examples.body: A owes B two separate debts. A pays a sum saying it is for the first debt. If B accepts, the payment must be applied to the first debt under s. 59.

hypotheticals.question: Can the creditor ignore the debtor’s direction as to which debt is paid?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. Section 59: if accepted, the payment must be applied according to the debtor’s express or implied intimation.

distinctions.title: Scope of s-59
distinctions.body: Applies only within the elements and consequences stated in the statutory text.

misconceptions.trap: The creditor always chooses which debt a payment discharges.
misconceptions.correction: Where the debtor indicates the debt, s. 59 requires application accordingly if the payment is accepted.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 59 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify multiple distinct debts. II. Test express or implied intimation of application. III. Apply payment to indicated debt if accepted. IV. Conclude.

examTips: State debtor’s right to appropriate when indicated.
